illustrative_same_date_comparison.interpretation: Demonstrates spatial variability at station scale on the same reporting date, NOT basin rainfall, a cloudburst footprint, or quantified flow risk. Measurement clock and station coordinates must be audited.

link_to_2026_event.reported_station_accumulations: Secondary-reported October 2026 SENAMHI values only; historical TXT ends in 2015 and 2013 respectively

methodological_guardrails: Never use -99.9 as 0 or interpolate it silently.
October maxima are maxima among available historical October dates only; missing years 2016–2025 prohibit all-time record claims.
No compare province-average IMERG directly with station point rain; use station coordinates and a validated pixel matchup with matching accumulation window.
No hydraulic inference, thresholds, probabilities, or activation predictions derived from a single rainfall peak.
A plausible station identity does not establish catchment/outlet linkage; preserve independent named features.
next_steps: Obtain original October 2026 XLSX/CSV for station-level near-term validation where possible.
Get SENAMHI station metadata and coordinates for Puerto Pizarro and Matapalo; fix station identity and datum.
Verify station daily rainfall accumulation hour for historical and 2026 series.
Match IMERG Early pixel/cell to each station after verifying location and time, then perform controlled sensitivity checks for point-vs-area dilution.
Use several strong historical events for detection QA without defining operational activation thresholds.
